message.name: FIToFICustomerCreditTransferV14
message.definition: Scope|The FinancialInstitutionToFinancialInstitutionCustomerCreditTransfer message is sent by the debtor agent to the creditor agent, directly or through other agents and/or a payment clearing and settlement system. It is used to move funds from a debtor account to a creditor.|Usage|The FIToFICustomerCreditTransfer message is exchanged between agents and can contain one or more customer credit transfer instructions.|The FIToFICustomerCreditTransfer message does not allow for grouping: a CreditTransferTransactionInformation block must be present for each credit transfer transaction.|The FIToFICustomerCreditTransfer message can be used in different ways:|- If the instructing agent and the instructed agent wish to use their direct account relationship in the currency of the transfer then the message contains both the funds for the customer transfer(s) as well as the payment details;|- If the instructing agent and the instructed agent have no direct account relationship in the currency of the transfer, or do not wish to use their account relationship, then other (reimbursement) agents will be involved to cover for the customer transfer(s). The FIToFICustomerCreditTransfer contains only the payment details and the instructing agent must cover the customer transfer by sending a FinancialInstitutionCreditTransfer to a reimbursement agent. This payment method is called the Cover method;|- If more than two financial institutions are involved in the payment chain and if the FIToFICustomerCreditTransfer is sent from one financial institution to the next financial institution in the payment chain, then the payment method is called the Serial method.|The FIToFICustomerCreditTransfer message can be used in domestic and cross-border scenarios.

rules.name: IdentificationOrProxyPresenceRule
rules.text: Identification must be present or Proxy must be present. Both may be present.

rules.name: IdentificationAndProxyGuideline
rules.text: If the account identification is not defined through a conventional identification such as an email address or a mobile number, then the proxy element should be used for the identification of the account.

rules.name: ThirdReimbursementAgentRule
rules.text: If ThirdReimbursementAgent is present, then InstructingReimbursementAgent and InstructedReimbursementAgent must both be present.

rules.name: SettlementMethodAgentRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to INDA or INGA, then ReimbursementAgent(s) and ClearingSystem are not allowed.

rules.name: SettlementMethodCoverRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to COVE, then SettlementAccount and ClearingSystem are not allowed.

rules.name: SettlementMethodCoverAgentRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to COVE, then InstructedReimbursementAgent or InstructingReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: SettlementMethodClearingRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to CLRG, then SettlementAccount and ReimbursementAgent(s) are not allowed.

rules.name: InstructingReimbursementAgentAccountRule
rules.text: If InstructingReimbursementAgentAccount is present, then InstructingReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: InstructedReimbursementAgentAccountRule
rules.text: If InstructedReimbursementAgentAccount is present, then InstructedReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: ThirdReimbursementAgentAccountRule
rules.text: If ThirdReimbursementAgentAccount is present, then ThirdReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: TotalInterbankSettlementAmountAndDateRule
rules.text: If TotalInterbankSettlementAmount is present, then InterbankSettlementDate must be present.

rules.name: TransactionIdentificationPresenceRule
rules.text: TransactionIdentification or UETR must be present. Both may be present

rules.name: AdditionalDateTimePresenceRule
rules.text: AcceptanceDateTime or PoolingAdjustmentDate or ExpiryDateTime must be present. All can be present.

rules.name: ReportingCodeAndInformationRule
rules.text: Reporting code or information must be present. Both may be present.

rules.name: RemittanceAmountAndTypeGuideline
rules.text: If Type/Code is equal to CREN, DUPA or REMI for RemittanceAmountAndType, RemittanceAmountAndType must not be repeated.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.

rules.name: ChargesInformationGuideline
rules.text: The repetitive ChargesInformation should contain all information on charges amount and which party has taken the charges, separately for each agent along the payment chain.

rules.name: UltimateDebtorGuideline
rules.text: UltimateDebtor may only be present if different from Debtor.

rules.name: UltimateCreditorGuideline
rules.text: UltimateCreditor may only be present if different from Creditor.

rules.name: InstructedAmountAndExchangeRate1Rule
rules.text: If InstructedAmount is present and the currency is different from the currency in InterbankSettlementAmount, then ExchangeRate must be present.

rules.name: InstructedAmountAndExchangeRate2Rule
rules.text: If InstructedAmount is present and the currency is the same as the currency in InterbankSettlementAmount, then ExchangeRate is not allowed.

rules.name: ChargesInformationAndInstructedAmountRule
rules.text: If ChargesInformation is present, then InstructedAmount must be present.

rules.name: ChargesAmountGuideline
rules.text: If ChargesInformation is present, then the currency of ChargesInformation/ChargesAmount is recommended to be the same as the currency of InterbankSettlementAmount.

rules.name: ChargeBearerAndChargesInformationRule
rules.text: If ChargeBearer contains DEBT, then ChargesInformation may be present to communicate charges that have been added for (the) InstructedAgent(s). If ChargeBearer contains CRED, then at least one occurrence of ChargesInformation must be present to communicate charges that have been deducted from the InstructedAmount by (the) InstructingAgent(s). If ChargeBearer contains SHAR or SLEV, then ChargesInformation is optional.

rules.name: InstructionForCreditorAgentRule
rules.text: If InstructionForCreditorAgent/Code contains CHQB (PayCreditorByCheque), then CreditorAccount is not allowed.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent2Rule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent2 is present, then IntermediaryAgent1 must be present.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent3Rule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent3 is present, then IntermediaryAgent2 must be present.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent1AccountRule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent1Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent1 must be present.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent2AccountRule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent2Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent2 must be present.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgent3AccountRule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent3Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent3 must be present.

rules.name: InstructedAmountAndExchangeRate3Rule
rules.text: If InstructedAmount is not present, then ExchangeRate is not allowed.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent2AccountRule
rules.text: If PreviousInstructingAgent2Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent2 must be present.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent3AccountRule
rules.text: If PreviousInstructingAgent3Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent3 must be present.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent1Guideline
rules.text: It is recommended that, when present, PreviousInstructingAgent1 is the closest to the DebtorAgent in the payment chain.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent2Rule
rules.text: If PreviousInstructingAgent2 is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent1 must be present.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent3Rule
rules.text: If PreviousInstructingAgent3 is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent2 must be present.

rules.name: PreviousInstructingAgent1AccountRule
rules.text: If PreviousInstructingAgent1Account is present, then PreviousInstructingAgent1 must be present.

rules.name: InstructedAgentRule
rules.text: If GroupHeader/InstructedAgent is present, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/InstructedAgent is not allowed.

rules.name: InstructingAgentRule
rules.text: If GroupHeader/InstructingAgent is present, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/InstructingAgent is not allowed.

rules.name: TotalInterbankSettlementAmountRule
rules.text: If GroupHeader/TotalInterbankSettlementAmount is present, then all occurrences of CreditTransferTransactionInformation/InterbankSettlementAmount must have the same currency as the currency of GroupHeader/TotalInterbankSettlementAmount.

rules.name: TotalInterbankSettlementAmountAndSumRule
rules.text: If GroupHeader/TotalInterbankSettlementAmount is present, then it must equal the sum of all occurrences of CreditTransferTransactionInformation/InterbankSettlementAmount.

rules.name: GroupHeaderInterbankSettlementDateRule
rules.text: If GroupHeader/InterbankSettlementDate is present, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/InterbankSettlementDate is not allowed.

rules.name: TransactionInterbankSettlementDateRule
rules.text: If GroupHeader/InterbankSettlementDate is not present, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/InterbankSettlementDate must be present.

rules.name: PaymentTypeInformationRule
rules.text: If GroupHeader/PaymentTypeInformation is present, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/PaymentTypeInformation is not allowed.

rules.name: NumberOfTransactionsAndCreditTransfersRule
rules.text: GroupHeader/NumberOfTransactions must equal the number of occurrences of CreditTransferTransactionInformation.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: The SupplementaryData building block at message level must not be used to provide additional information about a transaction. The SupplementaryData element at transaction level should be used for that purpose.

rules.name: GroupHeaderExpiryDateTimeRule
rules.text: If GroupHeader/ExpiryDateTime is present, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/AdditionalDateTime/ExpiryDateTime is not allowed.
